# Upgrade to a Technology Partner

Updated: Nov 11, 2026

This document describes the requirements and steps you must take to become a Technology Partner.

## Product journey

The product journey details the steps for Tech Providers to upgrade to become a Technology Partner on the Meta Developer Platform.

Becoming a Technology Partner gives you access to additional WhatsApp messaging solutions and configuration options. It also grants access to benefits such as:

- Training and support
- Analytics reports
- Client matching opportunities

The upgrade journey has these milestones:

1. Complete developer and Tech Provider onboarding.
2. Start the upgrade from the **App Dashboard** (Steps 1 and 2).
3. Get set up in Partnership Home and qualify as a Technology Partner (Step 3).
4. Complete program enrollment in Partnership Home (Step 4).

Qualifying as a Technology Partner and enrolling in a program are separate milestones. Completing setup doesn’t earn you a badge, and program enrollment doesn’t guarantee incentive funding.

## Context

### Definitions

During this upgrade process, you will come across these surfaces and definitions:

- **Meta for Developers** - The entry point for developer documentation and common tools and dashboards, including the [App Dashboard](https://developers.facebook.com/apps), the **WhatsApp** product panel within it, and the **Quickstart** panel.
- **Quickstart panel** - a panel within the **App Dashboard** > **WhatsApp** product panel. The Quickstart panel is where you can begin or resume a request for an upgrade.
- **Enterprise Center** - Enterprise Center is a new centralized platform that enables Meta to do business with external partners and vendors.
- **Supplier Connect** - Supplier Connect is an application on Enterprise Center that serves as a front to onboard external partners or third-party vendors (suppliers). It is a secure, self-service portal that allows partners to view and modify data, as well as carry out different business transactions such as:
  - viewing purchase orders
  - submitting invoices
  - tracking payments
- **Meta Business Partners** - Meta Business Partners are companies Meta has vetted for their technical skills and services, and their unique ability to help businesses grow. Partners are part of a respected global community and get access to unique benefits, including:
  - Training
  - Support
  - Analytics reports
  - Client matching opportunities
- **Partnership Home** - Your destination as a Meta Business Partner to manage your badge, complete program enrollment, track business performance, and request and claim eligible incentive funding.
- **Technology Partner** - A partner that meets the Technology Partner requirements and earns a Meta Business Partner badge. Partnership Home shows the full requirements and your progress.

### Eligibility requirements

To be eligible for an upgrade, you must:

- Successfully complete all [Tech Provider Get Started](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/solution-providers/get-started-for-tech-providers) steps.
- Have at least 2,500 average daily messages sent across Messenger, Instagram, and WhatsApp by the businesses you work with over the last 7 days.
- Work with at least 10 active messaging accounts. An active messaging account is a Facebook Page, Instagram professional account, or WhatsApp Business account that sent at least one message in the last 28 days.
- Have 10 or fewer low-quality days on WhatsApp this month. A low-quality day is a day when more than 10% of the WhatsApp phone numbers you manage are rated low quality.
- Keep your Messenger block rate at 3.5% or lower. Your block rate is the percentage of daily Messenger conversations where someone blocked a business that uses your app, measured over the last 90 days.
- Complete Meta Blueprint training through the [Meta Business Education Program⁠](https://www.facebook.com/business/learn/business-education-program). Your training status can take up to 2 days to update.

Partnership Home shows your progress toward each requirement.

### Getting support

## Step 1: Access the upgrade flow

In the [App Dashboard](https://developers.facebook.com/apps), navigate to **WhatsApp** > **Quickstart**, and in the **Become a Partner** section, click the **Take the next step** button.

![WhatsApp Quickstart panel showing the Become a Partner section with the Take the next step button](https://scontent-lga3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.2365-6/449066878_1486119818931696_7577685407324845454_n.png?_nc_cat=104&_nc_map=urlgen_bucketless&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=e280be&_nc_ohc=aZ4c6k_cS9oQ7kNvwGk4FwN&_nc_oc=AdrNeXCHKiPbiNpo9mmIj8m2Vq3Zp5prlFDb0xh0QF7_UbY9eh2iEKD5wwy5ATRlpjI&_nc_zt=14&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-1.xx&_nc_gid=fiXv3nsQX5nKGlNmyjZv_g&_nc_ss=7b20f&oh=00_AQR8_HT_x_XlNtQHp5D0VunM4r1ykThmg3HqNW8I7TpYeQ&oe=6B173AD6)

## Step 2: Initiate the upgrade process

On the **Onboarding** page, scroll to the bottom and click **Become a Partner**.

![Upgrade to become a Partner card listing access to trainings, analytics, and client matching with a Become a Partner button](https://scontent-lga3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.2365-6/449047177_1478359892790592_7722819495636981289_n.png?_nc_cat=101&_nc_map=urlgen_bucketless&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=e280be&_nc_ohc=sWr3VT9v76IQ7kNvwHMKukP&_nc_oc=AdpcQ2gVwJ_AI3yHc9BLg-Xa-7LQFw_2fHFaw95H1s_3-dLJk9xltEnZaiDz5w0YkVU&_nc_zt=14&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-1.xx&_nc_gid=fiXv3nsQX5nKGlNmyjZv_g&_nc_ss=7b20f&oh=00_AQQFL8G75zkA6tI0U8dFiIfaQA3RMqY3LvGvgWOZFjHhkQ&oe=6B173A95)

Keep in mind the following:

- Carefully fill out all business details because the information will be submitted and reviewed for approval.
- During a few of these steps, you will receive emails. If you do not see them, check your spam folder.

## Step 3: Get set up in Partnership Home

Open [Partnership Home⁠](https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fpartnershiphome.atmeta.com%2Fs%2F&h=AUBo4WXc9QwyxqJ_IdIbhgqVbWPmHL1I2_IrTUFJymSgcPcBodDB5Ga4cu5JBBz-aC6d-VAk_sMPkykDsT6xRHMaGLP_mcgQUV7xV2f-KB5WEv-CrHz8ZaLdANHeTo06VxFSMDfzfOdJIOC4) and sign in with Facebook or a managed Meta account, using the account associated with your business portfolio. A business portfolio admin must complete setup, which takes about 5 to 10 minutes. An admin is a person with full control of the business portfolio. To check who your admins are, go to [People⁠](https://business.facebook.com/latest/settings/business_users) in your business portfolio settings.

![Welcome to Partnership Home sign-in page with Log in with Facebook and Log in with a Managed Meta Account options](https://scontent-lga3-3.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.2365-6/901452917_1667214585137189_2617209632191636666_n.jpg?_nc_cat=109&_nc_map=urlgen_bucketless&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=e280be&_nc_ohc=GiiJWvO9-CMQ7kNvwGS9sGn&_nc_oc=AdpWx7HPB96DHqC9uhNTD31q9fKl9eK3BDQTg6hnO2PmDmI0FOnTZzQHsf0RlGQ5tiE&_nc_zt=14&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-3.xx&_nc_gid=fiXv3nsQX5nKGlNmyjZv_g&_nc_ss=7b20f&oh=00_AQQKjMtYE90ZTqne9exuijJ6jFxashex5qdpsoERLr5F0Q&oe=6B17636C)

1. Select and confirm the business portfolio ID associated with your partner relationship and badge. If you are unsure which ID to use, check with your Meta partner manager before submitting.

   ![Select a business portfolio ID dialog listing business portfolios with their verification status, with a warning on a portfolio where you only have partial access](https://scontent-lga3-2.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.2365-6/905143614_1667214605137187_6209689961988910746_n.jpg?_nc_cat=110&_nc_map=urlgen_bucketless&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=e280be&_nc_ohc=xac0yqaa5N4Q7kNvwGJ7q0p&_nc_oc=Adr1vDW0itg32RY7_7k7lc8YfppBxj-i9e1fdZpJtCnJwrjLcgYNOX5UBRYRAMTZ5nk&_nc_zt=14&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-2.xx&_nc_gid=fiXv3nsQX5nKGlNmyjZv_g&_nc_ss=7b20f&oh=00_AQQ1jrJ2BHgNqbRcAtwk02T_oU622Y6HznOIl43ZOSZF3Q&oe=6B1754D8)
2. Accept the Terms and Conditions presented in Partnership Home.

   ![Partnership Home Terms and Conditions page marked Pending acceptance, with a checkbox to accept on behalf of your organization and an Accept button](https://scontent-lga3-3.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.2365-6/903459847_1667214631803851_6364146150813495794_n.jpg?_nc_cat=108&_nc_map=urlgen_bucketless&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=e280be&_nc_ohc=ICSD-8kbzJsQ7kNvwEs8ipq&_nc_oc=AdpvKSY98YEzGy8OmQhHZN2zVOXqUBmGTpjahcnS_qmcVQnTarqeKBSgH8nrbVZHuhc&_nc_zt=14&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-3.xx&_nc_gid=fiXv3nsQX5nKGlNmyjZv_g&_nc_ss=7b20f&oh=00_AQR8NSK9DANU-kE5_rxuCIUt6qlxX8S4uF85tFfKJ6IBVQ&oe=6B176FA6)
3. Complete the compliance self-certification and any outstanding business verification tasks shown in the guided setup.

   ![Compliance Self-Certification form in Partnership Home with Compliant and Not compliant options and a Submit button](https://scontent-lga3-3.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.2365-6/904270860_1667214555137192_5537627376955952220_n.png?_nc_cat=103&_nc_map=urlgen_bucketless&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=e280be&_nc_ohc=2YNYaH585GwQ7kNvwHD66oS&_nc_oc=AdqIvKc060Z8xPVe7HOHD5GEv7NRd-Zn6ytaNCq94uvEEyqNPfgD2YC7W3-1nKr01B4&_nc_zt=14&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-3.xx&_nc_gid=fiXv3nsQX5nKGlNmyjZv_g&_nc_ss=7b20f&oh=00_AQQNbSxSNtex5XFWLSyq_u6RhJE5fP05U3VPY_gdnvJvNg&oe=6B174232)
4. Select **Technology Partner** and review your progress toward each requirement. Once you meet them all, click **Claim badge** to earn your Meta Business Partner badge.

   ![Partner qualification page with Technology Partner selected, showing completed developer account, App Review, and eligibility requirements, and a Claim badge button](https://scontent-lga3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.2365-6/903872290_1667214625137185_2579388321591269086_n.jpg?_nc_cat=103&_nc_map=urlgen_bucketless&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=e280be&_nc_ohc=RWhBBz_VlSYQ7kNvwF_VFeX&_nc_oc=AdojmQ9Gmty--jnlLnxlNkysIDQh4xmjpT1guSScjm0OPLjA3In0rg06MfnF-N4nIkk&_nc_zt=14&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-1.xx&_nc_gid=fiXv3nsQX5nKGlNmyjZv_g&_nc_ss=7b20f&oh=00_AQQigV4-r-y_VBbHCujILTnoXe2zj2jQGuYznH7VReI0-g&oe=6B176718)

After setup is complete, you may receive a confirmation email directing you back to Partnership Home. If you do not see it, check your spam folder. Partnership Home replaces the Partner Portal, so you don’t need a Partner Portal account.

![Welcome to Partnership Home confirmation email saying you've completed setup, with an Explore Partnership Home button](https://scontent-lga3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.2365-6/906073723_1667214618470519_2029441672942579022_n.png?_nc_cat=108&_nc_map=urlgen_bucketless&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=e280be&_nc_ohc=yQg8lGR32n8Q7kNvwHvqsY5&_nc_oc=AdoOMfnRu0LK_w1ZBH6tvmLVZw0PUaPuUSikYYzCu-yLmXv6UQGrDwNXH7Jnrw92i_M&_nc_zt=14&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-1.xx&_nc_gid=fiXv3nsQX5nKGlNmyjZv_g&_nc_ss=7b20f&oh=00_AQRzrvoiPOrm492M4XaOel3lc9Fy-0l8f9dkuL75vfUvZQ&oe=6B173C70)

## Step 4: Complete program enrollment in Partnership Home

Once you’ve qualified as a Technology Partner, enroll in **Meta Performance Accelerator for Business Messaging and Meta Business Agent** in Partnership Home. Select the business portfolio IDs you want to enroll and submit them for approval, then review and accept the program Terms and Conditions. Partnership Home shows the status of each ID.

![Enroll in Meta Performance Accelerator page showing submitted business portfolio IDs marked Approved, and a View terms button to accept the program Terms and Conditions](https://scontent-lga3-3.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.2365-6/896545088_1667214598470521_3218026474278321510_n.jpg?_nc_cat=100&_nc_map=urlgen_bucketless&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=e280be&_nc_ohc=TyyI1NANpUkQ7kNvwEdrIni&_nc_oc=AdolDUDRzEeetL3_ydEQDJhkIIM8xyw0P-eYH8MoqClMcfs1qY4pVoQbWh74JeIH8dY&_nc_zt=14&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-3.xx&_nc_gid=fiXv3nsQX5nKGlNmyjZv_g&_nc_ss=7b20f&oh=00_AQTslVEI69K9WZ_X_-P7-yL_7REJDCY8XA9BRyaamhAbhA&oe=6B174069)

If your business is already enrolled in the program, you don’t need to apply again. Complete Partnership Home setup and check that it shows your enrollment.

Program enrollment doesn’t automatically activate every incentive. To receive eligible incentive funding, complete any supplier onboarding tasks and sign the applicable funding schedules presented in Partnership Home.

![Confirmation that you're enrolled in Meta Performance Accelerator at the Registered tier, with a Get set up to receive incentives button](https://scontent-lga3-3.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.2365-6/904513116_1667214588470522_4132774948278895758_n.png?_nc_cat=102&_nc_map=urlgen_bucketless&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=e280be&_nc_ohc=EYbUFZFhtY0Q7kNvwEGl--y&_nc_oc=Adr0LWRHO2et5YQZ9brwEfIEQVMxIXRXmbaAEFn5mWCkSvIR-ZqS05FwDPFIQgR_hN4&_nc_zt=14&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-3.xx&_nc_gid=fiXv3nsQX5nKGlNmyjZv_g&_nc_ss=7b20f&oh=00_AQRjD8yPNcTAY2v1G0cMRJYwAAdc8ZV0-iFQT4QXXbIdBA&oe=6B175C82)
